reference.ghgIntro: The GHG Protocol Corporate Standard reports an organisation's greenhouse gas emissions in three scopes. This module derives each activity's scope from its sub-category; users never enter it.
reference.ghgScope1: Scope 1 — direct emissions from sources the organisation owns or controls (fuel combustion, company vehicles, fugitive gases).
reference.ghgScope2: Scope 2 — indirect emissions from purchased electricity, heat, steam and cooling.
reference.ghgScope3: Scope 3 — other indirect emissions in the value chain (business travel, commuting, freight, purchased goods, waste).
reference.isoIntro: ISO 14064-1:2018 classifies emissions into six categories. Each activity's category is derived from its sub-category.
reference.iso2: Category 2 — indirect emissions from imported energy
reference.iso4: Category 4 — indirect emissions from products the organisation uses
reference.iso5: Category 5 — indirect emissions from the use of the organisation's products
reference.iso6: Category 6 — indirect emissions from other sources
reference.standardsIntro: The two standards complement each other: the GHG Protocol defines the accounting method, ISO 14064-1 how the inventory is designed and verified.
